name: Whitley Award
summary: Annual award of project funding over one year for mid-career, grassroots conservation leaders who are nationals of an eligible country and are scaling up proven, community-based, science-led work.

geography.label: Countries not classified as a High-Income Economy by the World Bank (with listed exceptions)

status.quote: Applications for the 2027 Whitley Awards are now closed. Winners will be announced at our annual ceremony in April 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Whitley Awards recognise individuals backed by an experienced team or organisation that can demonstrate past success and an evidence-based approach.

geography.quote: Eligible countries are those not classified as a High-Income Economy by the World Bank.

access.quote: You do not need to be invited or nominated to apply for a Whitley Award.

window.quote: Awarded annually, Whitley Awards recognise grassroots conservation leaders, providing funding to support and scale up proven, science-based solutions that deliver lasting impact for both people and nature.

amount.quote: Each Whitley Award is worth £50,000 in project funding over one year.
